annotations.title: Guide to the texts and tools

description: Returns a plain-text guide to Besorah's texts and conventions: the editions, the Hebrew-based verse numbering, Strong's ids (H… Hebrew, G… Greek), book codes, and what each study tool returns. Use when the user asks how the texts, numbering and ids work.

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

name: get_guide
